outcomeNote: Rav Huna's practical extension of the mishna

segments.he: הִגִּיעַ לֶחָצֵר הַחִיצוֹנָה. אָמַר רַב הוּנָא: הָיְתָה בְּהֶמְתּוֹ טְעוּנָה כְּלֵי זְכוּכִית, מֵבִיא כָּרִים וּכְסָתוֹת וּמַנִּיחַ תַּחְתֶּיהָ, וּמַתִּיר הַחֲבָלִים וְהַשַּׂקִּין נוֹפְלִים.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: Once «he reached the outer courtyard,» he may untie the ropes that attach his bags to the donkey, «and the bags» of vessels that may not be moved on Shabbat fall on their own. «Rav Huna said:» If «one’s animal was laden with glass vessels,» which would break if he let them fall to the ground, «he may bring cushions and blankets and place» them «beneath» the animal «and untie the ropes and» let «the bags fall» onto the cushions.
